paragraphs.text: Reference is invited to paragraphs 3 and 4 of circular GZ-AML-2020-01 dated February 10, 2020, which prescribe the retention period for records of transactions and identification records. To support longer-running investigations, it has been decided to extend the record retention period for banks from 5 years to 8 years.

With effect from April 1, 2027, paragraphs 3 and 4 of circular GZ-AML-2020-01 dated February 10, 2020 on the retention period for records stand substituted by the text set out in paragraphs 3 and 4 of this circular respectively, which shall thereafter be read as paragraphs 3 and 4 of circular GZ-AML-2020-01.

The retention period for records of transactions shall be 8 years from the date of the transaction: banks shall preserve all necessary records of transactions between the bank and the customer for at least 8 years from the date of the transaction.

The retention period for identification records shall be 8 years after the business relationship has ended: banks shall preserve records of customer identification, account files and business correspondence for at least 8 years after the business relationship is ended or the account is closed, whichever is later.

Interim record retention period: until March 31, 2027, the existing 5-year retention period under paragraphs 3 and 4 of circular GZ-AML-2020-01 shall continue to apply, but banks shall not destroy any record that would be required to be retained under the revised 8-year retention period.

Retention of records of transactions under the revised record retention period: records of transactions undertaken during the financial year 2021-22 shall be retained by banks at least until March 31, 2030.

Retention of records of transactions under the revised record retention period: records of transactions undertaken during the financial year 2022-23 shall be retained by banks at least until March 31, 2031.

Banks shall review their record management, archival and storage systems and complete the changes required for the revised 8-year record retention period before April 1, 2027. The revised record retention provisions of circular GZ-AML-2026-01 shall come into force on April 1, 2027.
